method: Exact piecewise trigonometric support-function extrema over all rotations of the five-row touching-ball hull. Outward edge normals weighted by edge length cancel translation; three inward-offset halfplanes are feasible iff their weighted constants sum nonnegative. Circular bar cross-section provides a conservative fit criterion for the inscribed12-sided mesh. Actual GLB triangle/sphere checks independently reproduce baseline overlap and verify final clearance.
scope_note: The circular-bar calculation is a geometric model. Final acceptance also requires direct sphere-to-actual-exported-triangle checks; native witness spheres are diagnostic only, not product geometry.
